segments.title: Bring Your Squad Back From the Brink

lines.text: All hope is not lost when a teammate goes down!
When they fall, they leave behind a Reboot Card.
Pick it up, take it to a Reboot Van, and bring them back into the fight for a better shot at victory.
Weapons come in five rarities: Gray (Common), Green (Uncommon), Blue (Rare), Purple (Epic), and Orange (Legendary).
Higher rarity means better stats, so open Chests and swap out weapons when finding something better!
Set sail for sparkling Sprites from 2-4 PM ET and 9-11 PM ET!
Drop in with A$AP Rocky's Shock Rocket and a Self Revive,
and find more Fortune Sprite variants across the Island.
